articles.summary: ZUG, Switzerland, Jan. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ Lithium Argentina ” or the “ Company ”) ( TSX: LAR ) ( NYSE: LAR ) today announced preliminary 2025 operational results for the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation (“ Cauchari-Olaroz ”) in Jujuy, Argentina.
articles.title: Lithium Argentina Announces 2025 Production Results for Cauchari-Olaroz and Leadership Updates
